global_rule: A missing source hit is never a negative signal unless both entity identity and source coverage are proven for the full historical query scope.

This covers every requested 24/12/6/3-month cutoff. Exact reviewed foreign legal-name supplier aliases are scanned across the complete source files. A no-hit may be ABSENT_WITH_PROVEN_COVERAGE only within this defined CanadaBuys award-notice source universe; it is not evidence of no Canadian procurement or no Canadian presence.
